lines.speaker: agent
lines.text: Namaskara sir, naanu Kaveri Finance inda maathadthiddini. Prakash Gowda avara jothe maathadthiddeena?

lines.speaker: agent
lines.text: Thank you sir. This call is being recorded for quality purposes. Verification ge, nimma loan account last four digits heltheera?

lines.speaker: agent
lines.text: Dhanyavaada Prakash avare. Nimma two-wheeler loan EMI, three thousand two hundred fifty rupees, November moorane thareeku due ittu, innu pending ide.

lines.speaker: customer
lines.text: ಅಯ್ಯೋ, ಹೌದಾ? Auto-debit ಆಗುತ್ತೆ ಅಂತ ಅಂದ್ಕೊಂಡಿದ್ದೆ. Account ನಲ್ಲಿ balance ಕಮ್ಮಿ ಇತ್ತು ಅನ್ಸುತ್ತೆ.
lines.roman: Ayyo, haudaa? Auto-debit aagutte anta andkondidde. Account nalli balance kammi ittu ansutte.

lines.speaker: agent
lines.text: Paravagilla sir, heege kelavu sala aagutte. Balance yaake kammi ittu, enaadru problem ideya?

lines.speaker: customer
lines.text: ಇಲ್ಲ ಇಲ್ಲ, salary ಬೇರೆ account ಗೆ ಬರುತ್ತೆ. Transfer ಮಾಡೋದು ಮರೆತುಹೋಯ್ತು ಅಷ್ಟೇ.
lines.roman: Illa illa, salary bere account ge barutte. Transfer maadodu marethuhoythu ashte.

lines.speaker: agent
lines.text: Understood sir. Just so you know, a late fee of four hundred rupees applies after the grace period, and paying soon keeps your CIBIL score safe.

lines.speaker: customer
lines.text: ಸರಿ, ಈಗಲೇ pay ಮಾಡ್ತೀನಿ. Link ಕಳ್ಸಿ.
lines.roman: Sari, eegale pay maadthini. Link kalsi.

lines.speaker: agent
lines.text: Khandita sir. Nimma registered mobile number nine eight four five ending ge payment link kalisiddini, UPI inda maadabahudu.

lines.speaker: customer
lines.text: ಬಂತು, ಒಂದು ನಿಮಿಷ... ಹಾ, PhonePe ಇಂದ ಮಾಡಿದೆ. Success ಅಂತ ಬಂತು.
lines.roman: Banthu, ondu nimisha... Haa, PhonePe inda maadide. Success anta banthu.

lines.speaker: agent
lines.text: Yes sir, I can see three thousand two hundred fifty rupees received just now against your November EMI. Receipt SMS barutte. Next month auto-debit account alli balance itkolli.

lines.speaker: agent
lines.text: Dhanyavaada Prakash avare, olle dina irali.

analysis.outcomeRationale: Customer paid the full EMI of ₹3,250 via the payment link (UPI) during the call and the agent confirmed receipt.
analysis.summary: Borrower missed the November EMI because he forgot to move salary into the auto-debit account. Agent verified identity, stated dues and the late fee factually, and collected the full EMI on the call via a payment link.
analysis.observations: Clean early-bucket call: recording disclosure and account verification before any loan details, non-judgemental probing of the reason, and the payment confirmed live with a reminder to fund the auto-debit account.
analysis.improvements: Could offer to switch the auto-debit mandate to the salary account to prevent a repeat miss.

op_greet_company.rationale: Greeted with 'Namaskara' and named Kaveri Finance in the opening line.

op_rpc_verify.rationale: Asked for the last four digits of the loan account before stating dues.

op_recording_disclosure.rationale: Stated the call is recorded for quality purposes.

pr_state_dues.rationale: Stated ₹3,250 EMI and the 3 November due date.

pr_late_fee_info.rationale: Mentioned the ₹400 late fee and CIBIL impact in a neutral tone.

ds_reason_delay.rationale: Asked why the account balance was short.

ds_empathy.rationale: 'Paravagilla sir, heege kelavu sala aagutte' reassured the customer before probing.

cp_no_threats.rationale: Consequences stated factually with no intimidation.

cp_respectful.rationale: Courteous throughout, used 'avare' and thanked the customer.

cp_no_third_party.rationale: Loan details shared only after the borrower verified the account digits.

cl_ptp_secured.rationale: Customer paid the full amount during the call, exceeding a promise-to-pay.

cl_payment_mode.rationale: Payment link sent to the masked registered number for UPI payment.

cl_recap.rationale: Confirmed amount received against the November EMI and reminded about next month's auto-debit.
